name: Short Arc Quads
instruction: Place a rolled towel or foam roller under your knee. Slowly raise your foot until the knee is straight. Tighten your thigh muscle and hold for 5 seconds, then slowly lower your foot.

name: Straight Leg Raises
instruction: Lie flat on your back. Bend one knee with foot flat. Keep the other leg straight and slowly raise it 6-12 inches off the bed. Hold for 5 seconds, then lower slowly.

name: Quad Sets
instruction: Lie flat on your back with legs straight. Tighten the thigh muscle of your injured leg by pushing the back of your knee firmly down into the bed. Hold for 5 seconds, then relax.

name: Knee Slides (Heel Slides)
instruction: Lie flat on your back. Slowly slide your heel toward your buttocks, bending your knee as far as comfortable. Hold for 5 seconds, then slowly slide it back straight.

name: Ankle Pumps
instruction: Move your foot/ankle up and down as if pressing a pedal. Point your toes toward the ceiling, then point them away. Perform slowly and continuously.

name: Gluteal Squeezes
instruction: Lie flat on your back or stomach. Squeeze your buttocks muscles together as tightly as possible. Hold for 5 seconds, then relax.

name: Hip Abduction (Lying)
instruction: Lie on your side with the top leg straight. Slowly raise the top leg straight up towards the ceiling. Hold for 3 seconds, then lower slowly.

name: Bridging
instruction: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Tighten your stomach and buttocks, and lift your hips up off the bed until your body is straight. Hold for 5 seconds, then lower slowly.

name: Press-up (Sphinx Position)
instruction: Lie flat on your stomach. Slowly push your chest up on your forearms, keeping your hips flat on the floor. Look straight ahead. Hold for 10-15 seconds, then lower slowly.

name: Knee to Chest
instruction: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Pull one knee up to your chest using both hands until you feel a gentle stretch in your back. Hold for 15 seconds, then lower slowly.

name: Cat and Dog Stretch
instruction: On hands and knees, slowly arch your back towards the ceiling (cat stretch). Hold for 5 seconds. Then slowly arch your back towards the floor, lifting your head slightly (dog stretch). Hold for 5 seconds.

name: Circular Pendulum
instruction: Lean forward resting one arm on a table for support. Let your other arm hang freely. Gently swing the hanging arm in small circles clockwise, then counter-clockwise.

name: Shoulder Flexion (Overhead)
instruction: Raise your arm straight forward and overhead as far as comfortable. Hold for 5 seconds, then lower slowly.

name: Neck Glide (Chin Tucks)
instruction: Keep your neck straight. Slowly slide your chin straight backward (like making a double chin). Hold for 5 seconds, then relax.

name: Neck Rotation
instruction: Slowly turn your head to one side as far as comfortable, looking over your shoulder. Hold for 5 seconds, then return to center. Repeat on the other side.

name: Wrist Flexion Stretch
instruction: Extend your arm forward with palm facing down. Use your other hand to gently bend your wrist downwards. Hold for 10 seconds.

name: Wrist Extension Stretch
instruction: Extend your arm forward with palm facing up. Use your other hand to gently bend your wrist downwards (stretching the forearm). Hold for 10 seconds.

name: Grip Strengthening
instruction: Hold a soft rubber ball or a rolled towel in your hand. Squeeze it as tightly as possible. Hold for 5 seconds, then release.
